summary.text: NORLANDIA MYKLEBUST BARNEHAGE AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2006-10-26. Norlandia Myklebust Barnehage AS is registered to establish and operate kindergartens, along with activities that naturally fall under this. Its statutory purpose also allows it to acquire shares in other companies in the same and other industries. It was previously named GNIST BARNEHAGER MYKLEBUST AS until 2022-03-21. Its main industry code is 85.100: pre-primary education. The register shows 24 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2024 accounts, total operating income was 15 009 513 NOK and the annual result was -728 917 NOK; operating income was up from 11 325 812 NOK in 2023. The annual result fell from -728 917 NOK in 2024 to -772 961 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 2 385 886 NOK in 2023 to 1 656 969 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Ann Kristin Bøe Myklebust (daglig leder) and Yngvar Tov Herbjørnssønn (styrets leder). The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
